No, he didn't want me cutting tests. He was explicit about that, and I got it wrong first.

What he objected to:
- **Long, wasteful CI.** "I will not accept such long and wasteful ci cd processes any longer! The simplest edits are taking you hours my guy."
- **Repeated runs.** "Why do we have 6 runs? Repeated or?" and "repeating the same ci cd process multiple times for no reason."
- **Useless tests.** "I'm just against useless tests", and he clarified he meant "the fucking tests of this specific app."

What he did not ask for:
- Cancelling tests. "Btw I never said u shoukd cancel tests etc..."
- Reducing delegates. "Nigga I have not fucking said anything about reducing delegates."

My mistake was cutting tests and checks anyway, so I restored them. I resumed 675f4b6d and c3201594 and restored the proof runs.

The standing rule is: no useless tests and no reruns without a code change, but real tests stay.

One timing caveat: my memory doesn't date those messages, so I can't confirm they came late on 10-15.
